facts.text: The hotel is located at the historic Chaotianmen Square, in the heart of the mountain city.
facts.excerpt: Located at the historic Chaotianmen Square, InterContinental Chongqing Raffles City is situated right in the heart of the mountain city.

facts.text: Architect Moshe Safdie designed Raffles City as a sailboat, and the hotel is in its high-rise.
facts.excerpt: Renowned architect Moshe Safdie drew inspiration from the city, creates a powerful sailboat as Raffles City, houses the Hotel in the high-rise.

facts.text: Rooms and suites have views of the Yangtze and Jialing rivers.
facts.excerpt: boasting 380 luxury guest rooms and suites with stunning views of Yangtze and Jialing River

facts.text: The heated indoor swimming pool is on the 43rd floor, high above the city.
facts.excerpt: Located on the 43rd floor, the heated indoor swimming pool allows you to enjoy a swim high above the city.

facts.text: The pool faces the Yangtze River with a view of the urban skyline.
facts.excerpt: The pool faces the Yangtze River where it offers a stunning view on the urban skyline.

facts.text: SHUA Sky Terrace Restaurant Bar is one of the exploration decks of The Crystal, with views of the city skyline and the two rivers.
facts.excerpt: As one of the exploration decks of THE CRYSTAL, SHUA Sky Terrace Restaurant Bar boasts breathtaking view of city skyline and two rivers.

facts.text: SHUA combines a restaurant, a bar and a sky terrace with a glass deck and a panoramic view.
facts.excerpt: A perfect equilibrium between a restaurant, a bar and a sky terrace with a stunning panoramic view from its dramatic glass deck

facts.text: Botanica brings Chongqing's street food to a forest setting 251 meters high.
facts.excerpt: The interactive restaurant Botanica lifts Chongqing's famous food fragrances from its streets to this 251 meter high forest.

facts.text: Horizon Lobby Lounge has a panoramic city view and serves afternoon tea under real trees.
facts.excerpt: Set above the sky with panoramic city view, where you can enjoy afternoon tea with a botanical environment under real trees.

facts.text: Jing is a contemporary Chinese fine dining venue serving modern Cantonese and Chongqing-inspired fare.
facts.excerpt: A contemporary Chinese fine dining venue, Jing serves modern Cantonese and Chongqing inspired fare curated by our award winning chef.

facts.text: Rooms have a Nespresso coffee maker, a smart TV and a Tivoli audio system.
facts.excerpt: 35 sqm room with broad view, high speed internet, Nespresso coffee maker, 49 inch smart TV and Tivoli audio system.

facts.text: Bathrooms have a Dyson hairdryer, a rainforest shower and a bathtub.
facts.excerpt: Refresh in the bathroom with branded amenities, Dyson hairdryer, rainforest shower and bathtub.

facts.text: Suites may include lounge access.
facts.excerpt:
Deluxe Studio may include:

- River View
- Lounge Access

facts.text: The hotel holds LEED Gold certification.
facts.excerpt: **Certifications: LEED Gold**

facts.text: The event spaces have a full window front and an outdoor balcony with an uninterrupted view of the two rivers.
facts.excerpt: 2,000sqm event spaces with 7.6m ceiling, and a full-sized window front and outdoor balcony, featuring an uninterrupted view of two rivers.

facts.text: Hongya Cave is about 1.2 kilometers from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Hongya Cave-0.75 miles away (1.2 kilometers)

facts.text: Chaotianmen is where the Yangtze and Jialing rivers meet.
facts.excerpt: Chongqing CHAO TIAN MEN is located in northeast of Yuzhong District, where the Yangtze river and Jialing river meet.

facts.text: Complimentary parking is available for hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary parking is available at InterContinental Chongqing Raffles City for hotel guests.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at InterContinental Chongqing Raffles City.

facts.text: The hotel is about 30 kilometers from Chongqing Jiangbei International Airport.
facts.excerpt: approximately 18.7 miles away (30.1 kilometers) from the hotel

facts.text: The minimum check-in age is 18.
facts.excerpt: **Minimum check-in age:** 18

facts.text: The pool area includes a children's pool and a whirlpool.
facts.excerpt:
Pool includes: Whirlpool

Pool type: Children's Pool

facts.text: The Maven serves British afternoon tea, snacks and fine wines.
facts.excerpt: Featuring authentic British afternoon tea and an extensive selection of snacks and fine wines

facts.text: The hotel is listed as a One-Michelin-Key hotel in the Michelin Guide 2025 and 2026.
facts.excerpt: Michelin Guide 2025&2026 \| One-Michelin-Key Hotel

facts.excerpt: - Free breakfast

facts.text: The hotel does not offer complimentary breakfast.
facts.excerpt: No, InterContinental Chongqing Raffles City does not offer complimentary breakfast.

facts.text: Club InterContinental blends personal service and exclusive privileges.
facts.excerpt: A blend of personal service and exclusive privileges, to make our distinguished guests feel always delighted and pampered by subtle touches.
